name: Bitbucket
description: Configuration for Bitbucket Cloud repositories and Bitbucket Pipelines

schema.title: Bitbucket Repository & Pipelines
schema.description: Settings for the Bitbucket Cloud integration: where repositories are created, and who gets access to them. The bot-user credentials are not configured here: they are the BITBUCKET_EMAIL and BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN environment variables on your Application Lifecycle Manager deployment.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: The workspace and project new repositories are created in.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The Bitbucket workspace ID — the {workspace} segment of https://bitbucket.org/{workspace}/{repository}. Repositories are created inside it.

project_key.title: Project Key
project_key.description: The key of the Bitbucket project that owns new repositories.

installation_url.title: Installation URL
installation_url.description: Base URL of the Bitbucket installation, with no trailing slash. Keep the default for Bitbucket Cloud.

access.title: Access
access.description: Principals granted access on every repository nullplatform creates.

collaborators.title: Default Collaborators
collaborators.description: Users and groups granted permission on every new repository. They must already be members of the workspace.

id.title: ID
id.description: The Atlassian account_id of a workspace member, or the slug of a workspace group.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the principal is an individual user or a workspace group.

role.title: Role
role.description: The repository permission granted to the principal.
